Does Optimize5 work on AI search?
Yes. Optimize5 says it sets up your Google Business Profile so it is recognized by AI tools like ChatGPT and Gemini, and its setup includes AI-driven discovery optimization [1][2].
Does Optimize5 create and publish social media content?

Yes. Optimize5’s Social Media Posting program posts four reels a week to Instagram, Facebook and LinkedIn, made for real estate and lending, with captions carrying your name, license number and hashtags, and no approvals needed [3]. It costs $39 a month with a 14-day free trial [3].
Can I use Optimize5 and VEXI together?
Yes. Optimize5’s core is your Google profile, listings, reviews and AI search visibility [1]; VEXI’s is your social content.
